create_fasta_dataset: create a FastaDataset from a FASTA file path with cached indices for protein sequences
create_encoded_fasta_dataset: create an EncodedFastaDataset that returns token indices using a dictionary instead of raw sequences
check_fasta_exists: check if a FASTA file exists at the given prefix path using FastaDataset.exists
get_fasta_sequence: get a protein sequence and description by index from a FastaDataset instance
build_fasta_file_path: build the full FASTA file path from a prefix path using fasta_file_path
